fields.label: Auto Purchase from Material Planning
fields.description: When enabled, shows an Auto Purchase button on Material Planning to automatically create MR → PO → PR in one click for all unavailable items.

fields.label: Cut Sheet Tolerance (%)
fields.description: How far To Use (W1) + Balance (W2) may differ from the sheet being cut before a warning is shown. Cutting always loses a little to the saw, so a small gap is normal; the warning is there to catch a mis-typed dimension. Set 0 to warn on any difference at all. Never blocks a save.

Off: the sheet's own batch is rewritten to the Balance (W2) dimensions once the cut has been transferred -- same batch, same name, new size. On: the batch is never rewritten -- a Repack Stock Entry empties it and creates a NEW batch carrying the W2 dimensions, NOS and Kg, so documents already issued against the original still read true.
fields.label: Create New Batch for Cut Sheet Stock Entry
Process Loss Warning Above (%)
fields.description: Warn when a job's process loss is above this share of what was transferred. Above it, the material was probably not used effectively rather than lost in cutting — that is a purchase return to recover payment from the supplier, not a write-off. A warning only; the write-off is still allowed with a reason.

fields.label: Show Warning for Duplicate DUNO
fields.description: Warn on the Sales Order (Verify Raw Materials) and when saving a Drawing if the DUNO/Mark No is already used by a different Sales Order. This is only a warning and never blocks either one — a mark comes from the customer's drawing, and two customers reusing one is normal. Material Planning and Production Plan still REFUSE two rows sharing a DUNO whatever this is set to: weights, batch reservations and transfers are tracked per DUNO within a plan, so a repeat there would double-count weight and could send one Sales Order's material to another's supplier.

fields.label: Edit FG Stock Kg
fields.description: When ticked, the Kg of each finished-goods row on the Final Stock Entry can be changed to the weighed figure. When unticked, the Kg is read-only and always equals Nos × the drawing's Cust Weight (per Nos).

fields.label: FG Weight Difference Warning (%)
fields.description: On the Final Stock Entry, show a warning when the Kg entered for a drawing differs from its planned weight (Nos × Cust Weight (per Nos)) by more than this percentage, in either direction. It is only a warning: the entry can still be saved. Set 0 to warn on any difference. Applies only when Edit FG Stock Kg is ticked.
